requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

489-4399-4518--228.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Nylea.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
489-4399-4518--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

856-5147-5776-6277.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4279-5332-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5332-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1703-4984-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Academy Researchers
When Academy Researchers dies, Fool's Demise first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Academy Researchers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Academy Researchers enters, it triggers, putting Fool's Demise onto the battlefield from your hand attached to Academy Researchers.
Repeat.

236-1870-4873-5087.easyPrerequisites: Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
236-1870-4873-5087.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
236-1870-4873-5087.description:
Use Animating Faerie // Bring to Life to make Eternity Vessel a creature.
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4772-5478-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
4094-4772-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

4681-5170-5256-7918.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1978-3099-3139-5793.description:
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding two mana and gaining 2 life.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Great Henge which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Great Henge.
Repeat.

1116-1580-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4091-5984-7791.description:
Activate Moonscarred Werewolf by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Moonscarred Werewolf.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Moonscarred Werewolf.
Repeat.

670-1619-1734-6144.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-1734-6144.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Goliath Paladin.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, it triggers, returning Goliath Paladin from exile to the battlefield.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Goliath Paladin.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
Repeat from step 5.

206-3259-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2086-6797-6996.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3277-4377-5144.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Izzet Chronarch and exiling Ephemerate.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2440-6968-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-2292-4742.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5086-5183-5231-6753-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
5086-5183-5231-6753-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

149-2613-2757--143.description:
Earthbend a basic land you control.
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting the earthbent land.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the earthbent land, targeting the earthbent land.
The land triggers, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to Spiteful Sliver.
Spiteful Sliver triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Earthcraft trigger, untapping the earthbent land.
Repeat from step 3.
149-2613-2757--143.notes: The {G} in the mana cost can be waived if you earthbend a Forest and tap it for mana before casting Legolas's Quick Reflexes. You may need additional mana to earthbend the land depending on the method of earthbending used.

104-3490-4050-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4050-6720.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1497-2324-5220-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1640-4083-5759.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis is indestructible.
1640-4083-5759.description:
Deal damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Screaming Nemesis trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Screaming Nemesis instead of you due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat from step 2.

821-2173-2324-5220.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

122-328-2732-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant die, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers twice, exiling Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from your graveyard.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from exile to the battlefield.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Gray Merchant trigger, causing each opponent to lose an amount of life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, causing you to return Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose 4 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

1339-2122-5231-6774.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-5231-6774.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1170-1645-5954-6664-6751.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2267-2511-5058.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3334-3693-4120.easyPrerequisites: Walking Ballista has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3334-3693-4120.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
3334-3693-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

1267-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless from your graveyard with a memory counter on it as it is an Assassin due to Leyline of Transformation, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Medomai the Ageless token.
The Medomai the Ageless token triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling the Medomai the Ageless token.
During the combat phase of your extra turn, declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1692-4377-5730.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Aberrant Mind Sorcerer.
1692-4377-5730.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Aberrant Mind Sorcerer with haste.
When the Aberrant Mind Sorcerer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to roll a d20 and either return Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand, or put Walk the Aeons from your graveyard on top of your library.
Move to your extra turn, drawing Walk the Aeons if it was put on top of your library.
Repeat.

215-2092-3263-4617.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
215-2092-3263-4617.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin three times by paying {3}, adding {8}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}, returning Soulbright Flamekin to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

2281-2438-2732.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Saffi dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Saffi from your graveyard.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, returning Saffi from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1012-2363-5220.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Hangarback Walker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

283-2034-3263-3996.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Twilight Drover.
Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
283-2034-3263-3996.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {3} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
Illusionists's Bracers triggers, copying Twilight Drover's ability.
Resolve both Twilight Drover abilities, creating four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Spirits, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1636-2108-2913-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least 2.
1636-2108-2913-5220.description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Boulderbranch Golem.
When Boulderbranch Golem dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Boulderbranch Golem on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Boulderbranch Golem from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Boulderbranch Golem enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Boulderbranch Golem trigger, causing you to gain life equal to its power.
Repeat.

2909-3152-4445.notablePrerequisites: Leyline Immersion attached to a legendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
2909-3152-4445.description:
Activate the creature with Leyline Immersion attached by tapping it, adding {3}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Chakram Retriever.
Chakram Retriever triggers, causing you to untap the creature with Leyline Immersion attached.
Resolve Mind Games, tapping Chakram Retriever and returning Mind Games to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Chakram Retriever's ability to untap any other creature(s) you control.

360-1274-4186.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-1274-4186.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1703-2034-2792.notablePrerequisites:
Fool's Demise attached to Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1703-2034-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Great Whale, adding {C}{C}.
Fool's Demise's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning Fool's Demise to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, targeting Great Whale.
Repeat.
If the seven lands can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2557-4050-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two 1/1 Sliver creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Slivers, adding {2}.
Repeat.

618-1019-2816-5313.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Kiki-Jiki.
Your devotion to green is at least seven.
618-1019-2816-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Setessan Petitioner with haste.
The token enters gaining you at least 9 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
